AiTestingDefinition.description: Category 1b: Menu (Data 360 Knowledge RAG - Category = Menu)
AiTestingDefinition.name: Ambika_FAQ_tests_1b_Menu

inputs.utterance: Does Post Oak Smokehouse in Austin have any spicy food?

scorer.name: bot_response_rating
scorer.expectedValue: Post Oak Smokehouse offers spicy options including Cheddar Jalapeno Sausage ($16) stuffed with fresh roasted jalapenos, Pit-Smoked Charro Beans ($9) simmered with jalapeno, and Pulled Pork Shoulder ($20) served with tangy vinegar pepper sauce.

inputs.utterance: How much is the brisket at Post Oak Smokehouse in Austin, and what other smoked meats do they serve?

scorer.name: bot_response_rating
scorer.expectedValue: At Post Oak Smokehouse, the 16-Hour Smoked Prime Brisket is $28 per half pound. Other smoked meats include Heritage Pork Spare Ribs ($24 per half rack), Cheddar Jalapeno Sausage ($16), and Pulled Pork Shoulder ($20).

inputs.utterance: What vegetarian or gluten-free options are on the menu at Post Oak Smokehouse in Austin?

scorer.name: bot_response_rating
scorer.expectedValue: Post Oak Smokehouse offers vegetarian sides including Bourbon Skillet Cornbread ($10) and Smoked Gouda Mac & Cheese ($12), as well as gluten-free smoked meats including the 16-Hour Smoked Prime Brisket ($28), Heritage Pork Spare Ribs ($24), and Pulled Pork Shoulder ($20).

inputs.utterance: What desserts and craft beers does Post Oak Smokehouse in Austin have?

scorer.name: bot_response_rating
scorer.expectedValue: Post Oak Smokehouse serves Texas Pecan Banana Pudding ($11) for dessert and features 24 rotating local Austin and Texas Hill Country draft craft beers on tap, along with Texas bourbons and house sweet tea.
